summary: Pradeep P. Gokhale is a scholar of philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He earned his Ph.D. from Savitribai Phule Pune University in 1980 and served there as an Adjunct Professor in 2018.
Pragati Sahni works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. She studied under Damien Keown and served as an Associate Professor at the University of Delhi (attested 2026).

Praggnaparamita Biswas completed a Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University (2008–2013) under doctoral supervisor Ratna Basu. Her posts include Guest Lecturer at Ranaghat College (2013–2014) and Research Fellow at The Asiatic Society (2017–2021).

Pragya Jain earned a PhD from Mohanlal Sukhadia University (2021) and completed multiple other degrees and certificates. She has held posts including Assistant Professor at M. K. Sanghvi College (2011–2018) and Visiting Fellow at Oxford Centre for Hindu Studies (2025).

Prahlad Pradhan was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Patna University and Visva-Bharati University. He served as a Research Fellow at Visva-Bharati (~1938–1945), Principal at Gangadhar Meher University, and Professor at Utkal University (~1960–1975).

Pramod Chandra was an art historian and Indologist who studied at Georgetown University and the University of Mumbai (PhD 1964). He served as a professor at the University of Chicago (1971–1980) and Harvard University (1980–2004).

Pranabesh Bhattacharya, specializing in Indology and philosophy, earned an M.A. from Ramakrishna Mission Vidyamandira, an M.Phil. from Visva-Bharati University, and a Ph.D. from Bankura University. In 2025, he became an Assistant Professor at Sri Sathya Sai University for Human Excellence.

Pranshu Samdarshi, an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar, earned an M.Phil. from the University of Delhi (2010–2018). He held Assistant Professor posts at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (2019–2021) and Nava Nalanda Mahavihara (2021).

Prasanna Venkatesh T S works in computational fields and Indology. He has held positions at Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College as a Ph.D. Research Scholar and at the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad.
Prasarn Lao-areun is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied under Viroj Inthanon and completed a PhD at the University of Mysore (attested 2014).

Prashant Dharmadhikari works in Indology. He has held posts at K.G. Joshi College of Arts and N.G. Bedekar College of Commerce, and served as an Assistant Professor at the Central University of Gujarat in 2023.

Pratap Chandra Chunder was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He was educated at Hindu School, Presidency University (~1936–1940), and the University of Calcutta, studying under Prabodh Chandra Bagchi.

Pratapaditya Pal, a specialist in Indology, Tibetology, and art history, earned PhDs from the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge. He held senior curatorial posts at the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston and the Los Angeles County Museum of Art.

Praveen Verma earned a Ph.D. from Jawaharlal Nehru University (1991–1997). In 1998, he became a Group Leader and Staff Scientist VI at the National Institute of Plant Genome Research, later serving as Adjunct Faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2020.
Prayag Raj Sharma is a historian and Indologist who served as Dean at the Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies (attested 1973) and as Professor at Tribhuvan University (attested 1976–1990).
Prayoon Mererk is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He completed his doctoral thesis at the University of Delhi in 1985 under the supervision of Margaret Chatterjee and Mahesh Tiwary.

id: P:Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark
summary: Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark studied at the University of Paris and the London School of Economics, also studying under Bronisław Malinowski (~1935–1938). He worked for the Office of Strategic Services in the fields of Tibetology, history, and archaeology.

Pritam Saha, specializing in philosophy, Sinology, and Indology, earned a Ph.D. in Chinese Philosophy from East China Normal University by 2025. In 2025, he was appointed a Postdoctoral Fellow at Sun Yat-sen University.

Priyanka Basu earned a B.A. from Bethune College (2003–2006). She worked as a Curator at the British Library (2016–2021) and was appointed Lecturer in Performing Arts at King's College London in 2021.

Priyanka Pradeep Salekar studied at the University of Mumbai and Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute. In 2021, she became a PhD Researcher and Teaching Assistant at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay.
